sermon.title: What Are You Looking For?
sermon.speaker: Michael Silla
sermon.summary: Michael Silla asks what we are looking for. Herod heard John gladly but would not repent and wanted Jesus to give him a show; the sinful woman loved much, Zacchaeus overcame obstacles and received Him joyfully, the multitude tried to force Him to be king, and the disciples kept obeying in the storm. Seek first the kingdom of God, not a sign.

faqs.question: Can you harm God?
faqs.answer: No; you can’t take a six-shooter and fire at God, but you can offend Him.

faqs.question: What is the leaven of Herod?
faqs.answer: A doctrine of doing whatever you want while hearing the word gladly.

faqs.question: What did Jesus say about John?
faqs.answer: One of the greatest prophets in history.

faqs.question: Is mistreating the church mistreating Jesus?
faqs.answer: Yes; He asked Paul, “why are you persecuting me.”

scriptures.text_nkjv: Then he fell to the ground, and heard a voice saying to him, “Saul, Saul, why are you persecuting Me?”

faqs.question: What did Jesus tell Zacchaeus?
faqs.answer: In effect, “your house is my hotel,” and Zacchaeus was glad.

faqs.question: Can mature Christians stop doing the basics?
faqs.answer: No; you still have to do that stuff.

faqs.question: Can we force the second coming?
faqs.answer: No; just follow Jesus and wait.

faqs.question: What might distract the church?
faqs.answer: He mentions big lawsuits and opposition.
